requirements.statement: Linuxをcore completion platformとし、macOS portable suiteとWindows compatibility smokeの未実施は明示する。Windows wrapper成功をLinux互換証拠にしない。
Reverse artifactは非空、stage間非同一、source span再現可能、obligation coverage 100%を満たす。文字数だけの下限を内容証拠にせず、stage固有fieldとsemantic assertionで検査する。

conditions.source_condition: Linux is the core completion platform; all required core gates must run on Linux before Linux core completion is represented.
conditions.specific_negative: partial Linux required-core-gate set with another gate missing/not-run/unknown must remain incomplete

conditions.source_condition: macOS portable suite and Windows compatibility smoke have separate profile evidence; an unrun/not-confirmed profile remains explicitly unrun/unknown, never inferred green or silently N/A.
conditions.specific_negative: for a scope explicitly containing all three OS profiles, Linux green with macOS/Windows unrun cannot satisfy HAC-HIL-14a; missing/stale profile evidence cannot be offset by another profile

conditions.source_condition: A Windows wrapper success is not Linux compatibility evidence.
conditions.specific_negative: Windows wrapper green while Linux is unrun rejects Linux core completion

conditions.source_condition: Stages must not be duplicates of one another.
conditions.specific_negative: same content/digest reused as another capability or stage is rejected; five stage content categories are separately inspected
new selected source revision/field requires re-pinning; prior scope receipt cannot be reused, unknown remains unknown

conditions.source_condition: Selected-scope obligation coverage must be 100 percent.
conditions.specific_negative: missing c3, duplicate c2, one-way relation, missing endpoint, or less-than-100-percent at checkpoint blocks the applicable closure claim and preserves incomplete duties

conditions.source_condition: Character count or a length threshold alone is not substantive content evidence.
conditions.specific_negative: placeholder, copied source prose, coverage-table-only result without required as-is design/test, or no-finding without obligation relation is rejected even if text is present; this is the substantive-content implication of the accepted oracle, not a new numeric length threshold

conditions.source_condition: Stage-specific fields and semantic assertions inspect actual content.
conditions.specific_negative: the five distinct content categories (source map, observed contract, as-is design/test, intent hypothesis plus existing PO-verification state, gap plus owner/routing) are individually traceable; a required but absent stage cannot be replaced by a coverage table
